power.jaymospowers.zfighter.desc: A martial artist who fights with his fists and his ki. A foe that beats him owes him a rematch, every defeat makes him stronger, he trains to grow, a beating can send him into a Rage, and through hardship he breaks through to Super. Hold right click bare-handed to guard; raise it just as a blow lands to parry and counter. He eats an enormous amount.
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.starter: Charge Ki (hold, weak): ki slowly gathers while you stand your ground. Passive: strong bare fists (a weapon your class isn't trained with hits for a third)
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ability_: Charge Ki (hold): the aura flares and ki pours in (1 per tick) while you slow to a crawl; hungry work

G, your quick technique (a newly learned one goes on at once; switch on the training screen): Ki Blast (8 ki, a fast bolt), Ki Disc (12 ki, cuts through creatures and blocks for 60 blocks), Homing Volley, Solar Flash or Ki Barrier

V: tap for a Ki Blast; hold for 2 s and both hands fire a barrage. Sneak+V (hold, release), your charged technique: your lineage's wave (Ki Wave, or the Warrior-born's Crimson Cannon, the Verdant's Spiral Lance, the Frost-born's Frost Needle: a beam that travels out through everything in its line, 25-60 ki) or Ki Bomb (a big slow ball that bursts, 30-70 ki)
Flash Step: gone in a blink, up to 10 blocks the way you look; aimed at a creature, behind it (15 ki). Verdant: sneak+%4$s heals whoever you look at, or yourself (20 ki)
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.mode: Flight (hold %5$s and scroll up): take off on your ki and fly like Wind (hover; Sprint to cruise, faster in each form). Keep scrolling to change how you hold your arms (5 poses); scroll down to step back and land, or tap %5$s. Ki only, about 1 a second plus more at speed; you can charge ki in the air. Warrior-born: sneak+%5$s on the ground wraps your tail round your waist or lets it out
Starts the fusion dance (Z, then C) for you. Stand on the ground facing another Z Fighter a few blocks away; they answer it the same way.
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ultimate: Transform (%6$s): up a form, as far as you've learned (Super, Super 2, Super 3); sneak+%6$s: down one. Hold %6$s for the form menu: point at any form you have and let go. Once learned, the Spirit Bomb is on the menu too: pick it, then tap %6$s to raise it and tap again to throw it
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_hungry: Your stomach roars. You need to eat.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_starving: Too hungry to gather any ki.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fists_only: The weapon feels clumsy. A true fighter uses his fists.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_never_agai: You will not fall to %s twice. The rematch is owed.
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.special: Training (%7$s): spend Training Points on stats, forms and Limit Break. Sneak+%7$s: Limit Break up a tier (back to off past the highest): fists and speed up, health burns
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.title: Training
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.super_how: Reached only through hardship, never bought: live through hard fights, then break through near death.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.limit_how: Sneak+%s steps it up. Burns health; on a form, only one mastered 25%%, and twice the ki.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.earn: TP: blows landed, kills (more for bigger foes), time, walking, shadowboxing (hold Meditate, I; 3x in an Immense Field). Weights 1.5x (heavy 2x). Each stat also trains itself through its own kind of training: hover a stat to see how.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.growth: %s trains itself: %s%% to the next level. Today:
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_stat_train: Your training pays off: %s rises to %s.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.need_hardsh: You haven't been through enough yet.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_again: %s beat you again. The rematch is still owed.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_no_limit: You haven't trained Limit Break yet.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_limit_unma: This form isn't mastered enough to break its limit (25%).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_limit_hurt: Too hurt to break your limits.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_mastery_25: %s: 25%% mastered. The next form is within reach, and Limit Break holds on it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_mastery_50: %s: 50%% mastered. Going into it costs no ki now.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_rage: Rage! Your fists burn and nothing costs ki.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spirit_ask: %s is raising a Spirit Bomb. Sneak to lend your energy.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spirit_len: You lend your energy to the Spirit Bomb. Jump to stop.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spirit_wai: The Spirit Bomb isn't ready yet.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_technique_: %s is on %s now. Hold Y for the technique wheel to switch techniques.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.spirit_know: Learned (pick it on the hold-C menu)
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.ki_blast: A fast bolt from the palm. Cheap and quick.
A spinning blade of ki that flies 60 blocks, cutting through every foe and every block in its path. Only blocks as hard as obsidian, unbreakable ones and chests or furnaces stop it.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.homing_v: Five small bolts that seek out your foes.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.solar_fl: A blinding flash: all looking your way are blinded and lose you.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.ki_barri: A dome of ki for 3 s that stops arrows and halves blasts.
Hold to gather, let go: a beam through everything in a line.
Hold to gather, let go: a big slow ball that bursts where it lands.
technique.jaymospowers.zfighter.spirit_b: Gathered from all living things near. Hurts only your foes.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spar_not_f: Only a Z Fighter can spar with it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spar_start: Your shadow stands up to fight you.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_spar_lost: You're beaten. Get up and train.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.drills_help: Pick a drill. Each pays TP by your score, once every 2 minutes.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.drills_sub: Drills pay TP by your score.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.drills_pick: Click a drill to start it. Point at one to see how it goes.
drill.jaymospowers.zfighter.rhythm.help: Hit W A S D as each note crosses the line.
drill.jaymospowers.zfighter.ki_control.h: Hold Space to lift your ki, let go to let it sink. Keep it in the blue band.
drill.jaymospowers.zfighter.shadow_boxin: PUNCH: left click. BLOCK: right click. DODGE: Space. Be quick.
drill.jaymospowers.zfighter.precision.he: Click each target before it shrinks away. Sooner is worth more.
Born to train: Training Points come 25% faster, and Limit Break costs half the TP and burns half the health.
lineage.jaymospowers.zfighter.warrior.de: A tail, and every defeat grows you twice as much. Under a full moon with the tail out you become the Great Ape: hold left click to draw back a fist and let go to smash the ground where you look (harder the longer you hold). Sneak+Z wraps the tail away.
lineage.jaymospowers.zfighter.verdant.de: Heals on its own, throws a stretching punch up to 6 blocks on left mouse held (snatching items back), grows into Giant forms instead of Super, and sneak+B heals others.
lineage.jaymospowers.zfighter.frost.desc: Second and Final forms cost no ki to hold. Past Final lies the Golden form, which does.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_lineage_sa: Your lineage is already the one your blood gives.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape: The full moon! You become the Great Ape!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_wild: The full moon takes you. You can't stop it.
message.jaymospowers.villager_ape_turn: Something tears loose from %s's belt under the full moon. They're growing...
message.jaymospowers.villager_ape_crippl: The great beast crashes down. Its tail lies loose behind it.
message.jaymospowers.villager_ape_cut: The tail is cut away. The beast shrinks back into %s.
The Warrior-born's V: a beam in your own ki colour, wider and harder than a Ki Wave, with a bigger blast. Slower to gather, a little more ki.
The Verdant's V: a thin beam wound with a spiral that bores through walls and everything in its line. Longer reach, no blast.
The Frost-born's V: a needle of ki from one fingertip. Gathers in a second, costs little, reaches far and chills what it pierces. No blast.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.forms_hint: Point at a form to see what it still needs. Point at Limit Break to see how it works.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.form_open: %s is yours. Its mastery grows while you hold it; the next form needs some of it.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.techniques_: Point at a technique to see what it does. The letter is the key it goes on; + puts it on the technique wheel (Y), - takes it off.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_keeper: The Keeper lays a hand on your shoulder. You feel stronger.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_keeper_aga: "Once a day, friend. Come back tomorrow."
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_chamber: The Time Chamber: endless white. You train twice as fast here, and hunger comes fast too.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_verdant: The Verdant World: green skies over a quiet land.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_radar_none: No orbs left out in the world.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_radar_ston: The orbs are stone. They wake in %s day(s).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_radar_dead: The radar finds nothing here. It only works in the overworld.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_orbs_night: The dragon only answers at night, under the overworld sky.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_dragon: The sky goes dark. %s has called the Eternal Dragon!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_orbs_scatt: The dragon is gone. The seven orbs scatter across the world and turn to stone.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wished: %s wished for %s. The dragon grants it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_revived: You wake beside %s, whole again, with what you dropped.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_no_fa: No one has fallen in the last hour. Wish for something else.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_canno: "That is beyond my power for you." Wish for something else.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_wish_awake: Something wakes in you. Super is within reach.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter.wish_help: "Speak your wish." Point at a wish to see what it grants.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.power.desc: A Z Fighter gets 1250 Training Points. Someone with no power becomes a Z Fighter. Anyone else gets 30 levels.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.revive.desc: Everyone who died in the last hour is brought to your side, healed, with what they dropped.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.awaken.desc: For a Z Fighter not yet Super: enough hardship to break through at the next near-death.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.rebirth.desc: Your lineage becomes the one your heritage gives (Warrior-born, Frostborn and Verdant blood have their own; the rest are Earthlings).
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.blessing.desc: Everyone online is healed and fed, and has luck for a day.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_tir: You're still worn from your last fusion (%s min).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_wai: The dance! Your partner must answer it (Z, then C, facing you).
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_len: Fusion no. %s together: it holds for %s s
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_fusion_swa: %s takes control of the fused body
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_unfused: The fusion ends; you're two again.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_master_no_: %s looks you over. "No spark of ki in you, child. Come back when there is."
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_master_ref: %s shakes his head. "Earn this kingdom's trust first, and walk an honest path."
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_master_tom: %s smiles. "Enough for today. Come back tomorrow."
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_dark_maste: %s laughs. "No ki in you. You're not worth the lesson."
%s sneers. "You're too soft. Lose a few fights, or walk in the shadows, and come back."
%s teaches you, and it costs blood: %s.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_raid: %s falls from the sky beside %s! Every fighter is needed!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_raid_share: Your share of the victory: %s TP.
Your share of the victory: %s emeralds and experience.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_raid_won: %s is beaten! %s is saved; %s fighters share the prize.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_tournament: A tournament opens at %s! Step into the ring of light at %s, %s within %s minutes to enter.
No one stepped into the ring at %s. The tournament is called off.
The tournament at %s begins: %s challengers in a bracket of %s.
%s goes through: the other fighter never showed.
Into the ring! Knock them down or out of it.
%2$s is out of the ring! %1$s wins.
%s is the champion of the tournament at %s!
power.jaymospowers.zfighter.key.ultimate: Transform (%6$s): up a form, as far as you've learned (Super, Super 2, Super 3); sneak+%6$s: down one. Hold %6$s for the form menu: point at any form you have and let go. Once learned, the Spirit Bomb is on the menu too: pick it, then tap %6$s to raise it and tap again to throw it. Corrupted: sneak+%6$s in base form enters Corrupted mode (Super's strength, no ki drain; bleeds half a heart a second, heals you for a third of every hit, 3 rolls that blink to your target or behind it); again to leave
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_corrupted: The dark lessons have taken root. A mark burns on your brow, and the power in you has turned.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_corrupted_: Corrupted mode: your blood feeds the power.
Too little blood left to feed it.
Your blood runs low; the corruption lets you go.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_shout.1.2: I will NOT lose to you! AAAAAH!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_shout.2.1: You want my limit? HERE IT IS!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_shout.3.1: Every last ounce... ALL OF IT! HAAAAAH!
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_shout.3.2: Don't you DARE look down on me! RAAAAAAAGH!
hud.jaymospowers.zfighter.ape_fit: The ape has you! Hammer your movement keys to take it back
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.1: The rage boils over. The ape stops listening.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.2: Everything small and moving looks like an enemy.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.3: A roar tears out of you that isn't yours.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.4: The moon fills your skull. The ape takes the wheel.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.lo: There's nothing left of you to fight with. Only the ape, until the moon lets go.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_super_4_op: You have tamed the ape. Some of its fire is yours now: Primal Super.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.wo: You drag the ape back under your will.
Your mind comes back to you, ringing like a bell.
The ape snarls and gives you back the reins. For now.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_fit.ov: The fit burns itself out. You don't remember all of it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_ape_primal: The ape remembers you. The rage comes quicker now.
Half of every moon belongs to the ape.
You can barely tell where you end and the ape begins.
The ape is all that's left under the full moon.
The ape answers to you more easily now.
You're winning the ape back, moon by moon.
Your own thoughts are louder than the ape's again.
There's still some of you in there. You can fight it.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_super_4_no: Primal Super is the Warrior-born's alone, and your heritage isn't Warrior-born now.
Break through to your first Super before you reach for Primal Super.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_super_4_ap: Not while you are the ape.
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_super_prim: The ape's fire isn't all yours yet.
